title: Recipient Status Timeline
query:
MATCH (r:Recipient)-[:HAS_STATUS|PREVIOUS_STATUS*]->(s:DeliveryStatus)
            RETURN r.name AS Recipient, r.email AS Email, s.sent AS Sent,
                   s.delivered AS Delivered, s.acknowledged AS Acknowledged,
                   s.checked_at AS CheckedAt
            ORDER BY s.checked_at ASC
